pubmed.28893188: Developing genome-reduced Pseudomonas chlororaphis strains for the production of secondary metabolites.

bugs.desc: design_minimal_genome([]) and compile_synthetic_life([]) silently substituted the default 450-gene catalog for an explicitly empty gene list (falsy `or`). Now ValueError on empty; None still selects the default.

design_minimal_genome scored unrecognized categories with a bare .3 default (bypassing the named 'unknown' essentiality class) while a missing 'category' key crashed KeyError. Now missing -> explicit 'unknown'; unrecognized -> ValueError listing valid categories.

flux_optimize infeasible return dropped the product_reaction and growth_floor keys and reported objective 0 - a feasible-looking number for an infeasible LP (product GLC_UP with growth floor 1e9). Now the same key shape with objective None.

flux_optimize silently ignored glucose_limit/oxygen_limit when the model lacked GLC_UP/RESP - a toy model asked for glucose_limit=0 returned uptake flux 10.0. Now KeyError naming the missing reaction.

dynamic_fba returned a zero-point trajectory with no flag when initial glucose <= 1e-9 (24 h requested, simulation never ran) and never reported glucose-exhaustion early termination. Now the t=0 state is always recorded, with simulated_hours and a terminated_early flag.

fermentation_simulate accepted non-finite parameters (mu_max=inf) and never checked solver success - the failed integration surfaced as AttributeError 'list' object has no attribute 'tolist'. Now finite-input validation plus RuntimeError carrying the solver message.
